_about.jdk_home: Home folder of a JDK 21 or newer; bin/javac and bin/jar are run from it.
_about.minecraft_libraries: The libraries folder of a Minecraft 1.21.1 installation with NeoForge 21.1.x.
_about.version_json: The version manifest of the NeoForge profile of that installation, which lists its libraries; a list of files when the launcher keeps the vanilla libraries in a manifest of their own.
_about.neoforge_merged_jar: Minecraft and NeoForge classes in one jar with Mojang names, as the ModDevGradle plugin writes it to build/moddev/artifacts of a mod project.
_about.accelerated_rendering_jar: The Accelerated Rendering 1.0.14 jar for Minecraft 1.21.1.
